notes.title: Extreme Update
notes.content: This update represents an almost complete overhaul of the game. Explore a completely redesigned menu, two brand-new enemy types, and discover a holstered bow, fresh rooms, exciting new weapons, character skins, and even pets that assist you during gameplay. There's much more waiting—it's up to you to uncover it all!
